verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no documented HTTP models endpoint an agent could query to enumerate a live catalog, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. The `llama-model list` CLI command lists available models, but it is a local CLI subcommand, not a documented programmatic models endpoint, so it is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent enumerate the live model catalog programmatically via a documented models endpoint
